title: Send the casual-browser emails automatically after someone confirms on /subscribe

source.ref: Daniel approved the casual-browser copy (day 0, 3, 10) on 2026-11-16 and asked for it wired as the funnel's automatic sends.

detail: A /subscribe double-opt-in confirm queued only the welcome email; nothing enrolled the contact in a follow-up series, so the approved day 0/3/10 casual-browser emails had no way to send. The confirm now enrolls a first confirmation in the nurture sequence keyed 'subscribe' (lib/nurture/subscribe.ts), confirmOptin returns the contact id, and /admin/marketing/nurture lists the series as its own card so the three emails are editable. The sequence and its three steps (delays 1h, 71h, 168h) are rows in Frequency Community, created 2026-11-16. Sends go through the nurture cron and the lifecycle cap (one a day, three a week) once LIFECYCLE_CAP_ENABLED is on.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/(marketing)/subscribe/confirm/actions.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/marketing/nurture/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/enrollInNurture\(\{ contactId: result\.contactId, email, persona: SUBSCRIBE_NURTURE_KEY \}\)/.test(a))bad.push('confirm does not enroll the subscribe nurture');if(!p.includes('SUBSCRIBE_NURTURE_KEY'))bad.push('nurture admin does not list the subscribe series');if(bad.length){console.error('EMAIL-051: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
